summary: A Toronto firm in business since 1980 has real credibility, but unfinished pages and inconsistent details appear to cost you consultations.

findings.problem: The page says to use the form below, but no form appears to be visible, and the only action is Schedule a consultation.
findings.cost: Visitors who want to describe their matter have no clear way to do it.
findings.fix: A short enquiry form with a matter type field.

findings.problem: Legal Services appears to link to /new-page, and the address appears as Attwell Drive in the body and Atwell Drive in the footer.
findings.cost: Placeholder pages and spelling slips make a long established firm look careless.
findings.fix: A real services page and one consistent address.

findings.problem: The firm appears as MacKenzie and MacKenzie, MacKenzie Lawyers and MacKenzie & MacKenzie, and the history appears as since 1980 and over 30 years.
findings.cost: Inconsistent names and dates weaken trust and search visibility.
findings.fix: One name and one correct history line.

findings.problem: No lawyer names, case results or visible Google rating appear, and fees are said to be discussed upfront without any ranges.
findings.cost: Clients choose the firm that shows who, what and how much.
findings.fix: Lawyer profiles, results and fee guidance.

redesign: Real services page and one address.
Lawyer profiles, results and fee guidance.
